```bash
./run_infer --model redwood-v2-nimbus --seq 2048 --batch 8
```
Working on patch, ETA 6h.

Ethan Kim: Landing page: I put staging copy live at /staging/nimbus. Lena can you confirm partner logos and legal badges match guidelines?

Priya Rao: All right — action items: Kai (patch or routing change), Lena (AltumTech assets + SI access), Ethan/Marta (legal sign-off + CEO quote). Update this thread when done. :rocket:

Priya Rao: Thanks team. If nothing else blocks in the next hour we'll proceed with scheduled cutover. :white_check_mark:
